title: Can an existing pit accommodate new solution-treatment and ageing furnaces?
summary: A July 2026 group of Suneng documents proposes a bottom-opening solution-treatment furnace and a top-loading ageing furnace, both fitted to sites after old-equipment removal. Their main checks differ: the solution furnace needs a continuous downward path through the opening, basket and water tank; the ageing furnace needs confirmation of chamber shape, crane-entry space and pit supports.
